id: title:danielcarletti:pin the api version on stripe webhook endpoints

review.posthog_relevance: Stripe account compatibility and webhook payload integrity
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded implementation of Stripe API version compatibility. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H2 show the addition of the `api_version` parameter to the webhook creation and client initialization, while P1.F2.H3 adds it to the webhook payload. This implementation supports the stated goal of preventing compatibility issues with Stripe account versions on 'basl
review.uncertainty: The chunk lacks the definition of `StripeSource.default_version`, the implementation of `resolve_api_version`, and the complete context of the compatibility issue, which prevents a definitive assessment of the systemic risk reduction or broader capability. The tier is assigned based on the visible implementation, not the unverified outcomes or missing context.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the definition of StripeSource.default_version, the implementation of resolve_api_version, or the complete context of the Stripe account version compatibility issue. The score cannot be assigned without these supporting implementation and configuration details.
